name: patient_has_finding_of_morbid_obesity_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has morbid obesity.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of morbid obesity.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of morbid obesity.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of morbid obesity.

name: patient_has_finding_of_finding_of_walking_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently able to walk.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently able to walk.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not able to walk.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently able to walk.

name: patient_has_finding_of_finding_of_walking_now@@performed_slowly
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's ability to walk is performed slowly.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently able to walk and the walking is performed slowly.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently able to walk but not performed slowly.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the walking is performed slowly.

name: patient_has_finding_of_finding_of_walking_now@@sustained_for_twenty_minutes
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's ability to walk is sustained for twenty minutes.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently able to walk and the walking is sustained for twenty minutes.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently able to walk but not sustained for twenty minutes.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the walking is sustained for twenty minutes.

name: patient_has_finding_of_walking_now@@performed_slowly@@sustained_for_twenty_minutes
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently able to walk, with the walking performed slowly and sustained for twenty minutes.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently able to walk, the walking is performed slowly, and the walking is sustained for twenty minutes.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently able to walk, but either the walking is not performed slowly or is not sustained for twenty minutes.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently able to walk slowly for twenty minutes.
